name: omniclip
description: One clipboard for every device on your Wi-Fi

scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:web && npm run dev -w @omniclip/desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:web && npm run dist:mac -w @omniclip/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:web && npm run dist:win -w @omniclip/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/protocol && tsc -p apps/hub && tsc -p apps/desktop && tsc -p apps/web
